lightfoot-col-phm: J. B. Lightfoot, Saint Paul's Epistles to the Colossians and to Philemon (London: Macmillan, 1875; later editions), introduction and notes on Philemon
laparola-apparatus: La Parola: Greek New Testament with variant readings (laparola.net), the online apparatus for the New Testament, giving the witnesses for each reading
robertson-word-pictures: A. T. Robertson, Word Pictures in the New Testament, on the Epistle to Philemon
chrysostom-philemon: John Chrysostom, Argument and Homilies on the Epistle to Philemon (late 300s), in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series 1, vol. 13
jerome-philemon: Jerome, Commentary on the Epistle to Philemon, with its preface defending the letter (the Latin quoted in J. B. Lightfoot's introduction to Philemon)
pliny-letters-9: Pliny the Younger, Letters 9.21 and 9.24, to Sabinianus, on a freedman who had offended him
digest-21-1: The Digest of Justinian (AD 533), book 21, title 1 (the edict of the market officials on the sale of slaves), 21.1.17.4 and 21.1.43.1
tolmie-amicus-domini: D. Francois Tolmie, "The origin and development of the amicus domini hypothesis in Philemon research," LitNet (2025)
callahan-embassy: Allen Dwight Callahan, Embassy of Onesimus: The Letter of Paul to Philemon (Trinity Press International, 1997)
knox-philemon: John Knox, Philemon among the Letters of Paul (1935; revised edition 1959)
church-philemon-rhetoric: F. Forrester Church, "Rhetorical Structure and Design in Paul's Letter to Philemon," Harvard Theological Review (1978): 17-33
heil-philemon-chiasm: John Paul Heil, "The Chiastic Structure and Meaning of Paul's Letter to Philemon," Biblica 82 (2001): 178-206
birdsall-presbytes: J. N. Birdsall, "Presbytēs in Philemon 9: A Study in Conjectural Emendation," New Testament Studies 39.4 (1993): 625-630
welborn-old-paul: Laurence Welborn, "The Old Paul: Philemon 9 in Light of Recent Research on the Experience and Ideology of Age in Antiquity," New Testament Studies 71.2 (2025): 218-230
barnes-notes-philemon: Albert Barnes, Notes on the New Testament, on Philemon, with his closing remarks on slavery
jones-christian-index-1845: Charles Colcock Jones, his account of preaching on Philemon to an enslaved congregation, from the Georgia Christian Index, reprinted in the Signal of Liberty, 1 September 1845
luther-preface-philemon: Martin Luther, preface to the Epistle to Philemon in his German New Testament, as quoted in English by J. B. Lightfoot in his commentary on Philemon
calvin-philemon: John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistle to Philemon, in Commentaries on the Epistles to Timothy, Titus, and Philemon, trans. William Pringle (Calvin Translation Society; read at ccel.org)
theodore-philemon: Theodore of Mopsuestia, commentary on Philemon (surviving in a Latin translation, printed in the Spicilegium Solesmense, vol. 1; the passages quoted in J. B. Lightfoot's commentary on Philemon)
aquinas-philemon: Thomas Aquinas, Commentary on the Epistle of Paul to Philemon, trans. Ralph McInerny, in Thomas Aquinas, Selected Writings (Penguin, 1998), revised by Joseph Kenny, O.P. (isidore.co)
fuller-wayland-1845: Richard Fuller and Francis Wayland, Domestic Slavery Considered as a Scriptural Institution: In a Correspondence between the Rev. Richard Fuller of Beaufort, S.C., and the Rev. Francis Wayland of Providence, R.I. (1845; Internet Archive scan), Fuller's letters, pp. 189-190 and 212
wiki-phm-variants: Wikipedia, "Textual variants in the Epistle to Philemon" (consulted 2026), witness lists for 1:1, 1:5 and 1:6 (a secondary list, not the apparatus itself)
wiki-phm-mss: Wikipedia, "Papyrus 61", "Papyrus 87" and "Codex Claromontanus" (consulted 2026), on their dates and contents
